candidate_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(c:CR) WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL WITH DISTINCT c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason, c.summaryOfChange AS summary
question_en: Return the change reasons and summaries of CRs approved by agreements (approved-change review).
